text: A solution seemed in sight, and even Cecil, who had been ostentatiously drinking his tea at the view, felt the eternal attraction of Chance, and turned round. But this did not do, either. “Please—please—I know I am a sad spoil-sport, but it would make me wretched. I should practically be robbing the one who lost.” “Freddy owes me fifteen shillings,” interposed Cecil. “So it will work out right if you give the pound to me.” “Fifteen shillings,” said Miss Bartlett dubiously.
